title: fr.haptic.tap arguments
description: 1.1. A train of `count` taps (0 = until stop), one every `period_ms`, each on for `ms` at `level` %; with `accent` N > 0 the first tap and every Nth after it are at `accent_level` instead. A tap while a train runs changes it in place: the next tap comes period_ms after the last one started (at once if that has passed), the count starts again, the accent counts on; no done. Anything else running is replaced. A change is not a start: never BUSY. BUSY as pulse; INVALID_ARGS for ms 0, ms >= period_ms, ms above max_on_ms, or a train whose worst 10 s could spend the cooldown budget: ceil(10000 / period_ms) x (ms + 1) >= cooldown_pct x 100 (when cooldown_pct < 100); a train started on an unspent budget is then never cut for it.

accent.description: every Nth tap from the first at accent_level; 0 = none (0..32)
